body:
Found during #570's requested memory isolation. The accepted replacement20 image ships libgstopengl.so, but GStreamer reports that libgstcontroller-1.0.so.0 is missing. The generic post-install hook removes it; the ROCKNIX override enables GL plugins without restoring this dependency. The external plugin scanner is also absent because tools=disabled suppresses that helper. These are observed packaging failures, not a proven explanation for the owner hang.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: load the actual installed plugins with a fresh private registry, compare the original missing-dependency control with the retained-library/scanner payload, then repeat a bounded unauthenticated browser workload. No owner account/device operation.

Upgrade path: accepted images have these missing runtime components. A corrected immutable SYSTEM supplies them on both clean install and retained-storage upgrade; credentials and selected cloud folders are unaffected.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Recipe keeps the required controller library and scanner; pkgcheck and real package install controls retain their exact outputs.
- [x] VM original-failure and supplied-payload success controls demonstrate plugin loading with a fresh registry (original rc1; exact target library/helper rc0). Actual corrected-package proof remains in the recipe criterion.
- [x] Bounded browser comparison records389.1MiB peak PSS, reviewed loaded frame, zero GStreamer warnings and original exit0; it does not resolve #570 or prove the unmodified recipe repaired.
- [x] Next assembled image verifies the installed dependency closure, including fresh and retained-state qualification.

Historical October13 evidence: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-13-webkit-versions/README.md, gstreamer-inputs.json, gstreamer-result.json, gstreamer-vm-proof.json and headroom-result.json. Corrected scoped recipe is published in next at2292e9a298, with package/VM validation and both exact-head hosted checks successful. Fresh actual-package original255/fixed0 controls pass with no scanner override. Current-engine public-page run loads without GStreamer warnings, with similar memory use. #570 remains unresolved. At that checkpoint, final assembled-image clean/retained dependency closure was still required; the completion evidence below supersedes that pending status.

October14 final criterion verified: corrected image fac608ff / ES3178 retains controller, scanner and net libraries and all four linked consumers. Actual artifact readback plus fresh installed UI/default-loader run230909Z-21fa45d0 and real retained update/default-loader run231504Z-04208eaf pass. The normal update changes boot ID and preserves selected settings/history bytes and modes; protected base SHA/stat remain equal. Three loader commands return0 with no warning on each boot. Original outer results are0, all owners exited, admissions consumed. Original failed UI/net diagnostic remain failures. Evidence is published in0457ac18cd: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-14-gstnet-corrected-image/, corrected-image-ui/, and corrected-retained-loader/. The narrow net retention repair restores existing upstream ROCKNIX project behavior. This resolves packaging; it does not establish a universal browser memory cure or close#570.
